reason: Prior results do not establish a promoted optimization: the K-loop variants failed promotion, and noisy scores limit causal claims. I ranked distinct changes to the timed n=512 path first. Grouped stores, A packing, and the packing loop target existing work directly; prefetch and store-address changes are plausible but need assembler and bounds checks. Packing B is lower because the current B loads are already contiguous. Tail alignment is last because it changes only the fallback, while n=512 uses the AOT path. All gains remain unverified.
